name: Jules
summary: Google's asynchronous AI coding agent for GitHub repositories.
description: Jules is Google's autonomous coding agent: it connects to GitHub repositories, works on tasks in the background in a cloud VM, and returns changes as pull requests to review. It differs from in-editor assistants by being fully asynchronous. The free plan includes 15 tasks per day and 3 concurrent tasks; higher limits come with Google AI Pro ($19.99/month) and Ultra.
